Sherrie Maricle was born in Buffalo, New York on September 2, 1963. She currently balances a career as a drummer, band leader, composer and educator. Sherrie has performed with Clark Terry, Dizzy Gillespie and Slam Stewart, and records with the Diva Big Band and her quintet, Five Play.
Sherrie was interviewed in Clearwater Beach, Florida on March 18, 2001, by Monk Rowe, Director of the Hamilton College Jazz Archive.
